title: Compact-support base change at finite coefficients
statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$ be separated of finite type and admit a compactification $c=(j,p)$, with $j:X\hookrightarrow\overline X$ a quasi-compact open immersion and $p:\overline X\to Y$ proper. Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring and $g:Y'\to Y$ any morphism. Form the cartesian compact-support square [def-cbc-compact-support-square] with projections $g':X'=X\times_Y Y'\to X$ and $f':X'\to Y'$, and the base-changed compactification $c'=(j',p')$. For every complex $K\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], the exchange map of [def-cbc-exchange-map]
$$\operatorname{Ex}_!^c(K):g^{-1}Rf_!^cK\longrightarrow Rf'_!^{c'}g'^{-1}K$$
is an isomorphism in $D^+(Y'_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$, where $Rf_!^c=Rp_*j_!$ [def-weil-pbc-projection-compactification]. The maps agree under the canonical comparisons obtained from the proper/open refinement maps [def-weil-pbc-proper-open-comparison], independently of $c$ and of the common refinement used to compare compactifications [lem-cbc-compactifiable-cofiltered]. Consequently they define the compactification-independent map $\operatorname{Ex}_!:g^{-1}Rf_!K\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf'_!g'^{-1}K$. They are natural in $K$, are identities for identity base changes, and satisfy horizontal and vertical pasting after inserting the canonical inverse-image associativity and compact-support composition isomorphisms. Vertical pasting is asserted for composable compact-support squares (so compactifications of both morphisms and their composite are supplied); composition is computed using the compatible towers of [lem-cbc-compactifiable-compatible-tower]. No hypothesis on $g$ or on residue characteristics, no constructibility, and no qcqs hypothesis on the base schemes is required.

lean.statement: theorem compactSupportFiniteTorsion (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ] {X Y X' Y' : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} {g : Y' ⟶ Y} {g' : X' ⟶ X} [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) (c : Compactification f) : (∀ K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)), IsIso ((rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationPlusBaseChangeMap Λ sq c).app K)) ∧ (∀ (d : Compactification f) (r : c.Refinement d) (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))), compactSupportProperOpenRefinementMap Λ r K = ((derivedPlusFormalism (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).shriekIso d c).hom.app K)
lean.note: Mixed record: the new theorem supplies objectwise invertibility and identifies every specified proper/open refinement map with the canonical shriekIso, without requiring the refinement square to be Cartesian. The recorded existing upstream declarations supply identity, horizontal pasting, compactification-independent exchange, vertical pasting, and composition computed by any compatible tower. They specialize to derivedPlusFormalism (ModuleCat Λ); its HasBaseChange, HasProperExchange and HasProperBaseChange instances require only the finite coefficient ring. QuasiCompact and HasCompactification hypotheses in the canonical clauses follow from finite type, the supplied compactifications and their base changes. The general proper/open comparison is deliberately not replaced by upstream refinementComparison, which has an additional Cartesian-square argument.
